value.rationale: A natural structured least-squares error class modeling new components orthogonal to existing data design has exact, dimension- and conditioning-independent prediction sensitivity. The proof exhibits universal rank-one worst perturbations, a sharp residual-dependent transition to saturation and unexpectedly second-order sensitivity for consistent fits, replacing inconclusive first-order condition-number bounds on this class.
